other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Chhattisgarh
Must have passed at least Higher Secondary (12th) examination from a recognized board
Must be registered in a District Employment and Self-Employment Guidance Center of Chhattisgarh, with registration at least two years old as of the application date
Applicant must have no personal source of income and the family annual income must not exceed Rs.250,000
Only one member per family can receive the allowance; priority is given to the older member, then to the member who registered earlier, then to the member with higher educational qualification
If any family member is employed in any government or local body job other than Class‑IV or Group‑D, the applicant is ineligible
If the applicant is offered self‑employment or any job in the government or private sector and does not accept the offer, the applicant is ineligible
Family members of current or former Ministers, State Ministers, Members of Parliament, State Legislatures, Mayors of Municipal Corporations, and Chairpersons of District Panchayats are ineligible
Family members of pensioners receiving a monthly pension of Rs.10,000 or more are ineligible
Families that have paid income tax in the previous assessment year are ineligible
Family members of professionals such as engineers, doctors, lawyers, chartered accountants, and architects registered with professional bodies are ineligible
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of Rs.2500 per month is provided to eligible unemployed youth.
